$comment: Descriptive, derived from the types the bounded parser reads; the parser is the only authority on validity. Where the parser reads two versions of a document with one type, this schema admits what that type admits, including members the later version adds. Byte, depth and count bounds are recorded in x-rustev-parse-limits (a string length here counts characters, the parser counts bytes), and rules applied when a plan is compiled are stated in field descriptions, not enforced here.

CancelSupport.description: How far the remote side supports cancellation (spec 009, 3.2.4).

oneOf.description: A cancel is accepted; a stop is never confirmed.
A cancel is answered with a confirmed stop and its final charge.

CostBound.description: A backend's per-call cost disclosure, before dispatch.

oneOf.description: The call cannot cost more than this.

Determinism.description: Declared determinism of a backend, weakest first.

Disclosure.description: What a served identity is worth (spec 009, 3.7).

oneOf.description: The remote side guarantees the identity.
The remote side said so; unverified.
Nothing is known. Never replaced by a requested model or a slug.

max_bytes.description: Largest projected input, in canonical JSON bytes.

max_options.description: The most options, levels or candidates one request may carry.

OutputKind.description: What a backend returns for an operation (design section 8.2).

RemoteTerms.description:
Terms negotiated beside the descriptor (spec 009, 3.2.4). The runtime
never reads them; the adapter enforces and records them.

cost.description:
The per-call cost disclosure, in the remote side's units. `bounded`
only when the remote side enforces that per-call maximum (3.8.1).

idempotency_window_ms.description: How long an attempt id is remembered for idempotency (3.3.2).

privacy.description: Privacy options the remote side accepts (3.8.2), by name.

refusals_charged.description:
False only when the remote side documents that refused requests are
not charged (3.6), which permits `observed{0}` for a refusal.

ServedTerms.description:
Served-identity disclosure as negotiated. `identity` is the pinned
identity, present exactly when `disclosure` is `pinned`.

description:
The chosen version and, per hosted backend, its descriptor, descriptor
identity and terms.
